label: unstated
reason: The docstring mentions a block size and a remainder but never says how the remainder is distributed (the first `remainder` partitions each get one extra element), so a programmer could give the extra element to the last partition and fail on the 5-element, 2-partition case.
missing: When the list length does not divide evenly, the leftover elements go one each to the earliest partitions, so the first `remainder` partitions are one element longer than the rest.
